headline: Your AI chief
of staff.
dek: Quinn's "Morning Loop" agent reads his work tools every weekday at 8 AM and hands him a brief before he opens his laptop.

callouts.title: Sources
callouts.text: Outlook mail, calendar and To-Do, Slack, Asana, SharePoint.

callouts.title: Connectors
callouts.text: Approved enterprise connectors reach into each source.

callouts.title: Schedule
callouts.text: Runs weekdays at 8 AM in the cloud, laptop closed.

callouts.title: Outputs
callouts.text: Flags misses, syncs to-dos to Asana, sends a brief.

side.title: Closing the loop
side.text: At the end of the day he replies to the brief with what happened, and it updates everything.

items.title: No new tools
items.text: Uses the stack you already pay for.

sources: Fringe Lines podcast, Oct 30, 2026; Quinn's Morning Loop architecture slide.
